jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner, India (Mumbai/ Bangalore)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The HR Business Partner team at OpenAI supports managers and employees as teams grow, perform and adapt. We work alongside managers at all levels to resolve day-to-day people challenges, build management capability and create the conditions for teams to do their best work.

Our expertise spans team effectiveness, talent development, manager coaching, employee relations and change management, grounded in our Contributions & Impact (C&I) culture. We operate with urgency, empathy and sound judgment, valuing sincerity, collaboration and meaningful impact.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior HR Business Partner. This role will primarily support teams in India, with a focus on Go-to-Market and selected other functions. The portfolio may also include support for teams in other APAC markets as business needs evolve. You’ll provide hands-on support to managers at all levels, owning day-to-day people work and helping teams grow and scale effectively.

Your GTM partnership will span teams such as Sales, Technical Success, Partnerships and Marketing. Across your portfolio, you’ll build a deep understanding of business priorities and use that context to prioritise and deliver practical people support.

As a hands-on partner to managers at all levels, you will use independent judgment to coach managers, resolve people issues and follow through on day-to-day work as teams scale. You will own delivery across your portfolio, working closely with the International HRBP Leader, Recruiting, Finance, Employment Legal and People centres of expertise, and involving specialist partners when needed.

This is an individual contributor role, based in Mumbai or Bangalore. We operate in a hybrid work model: three days in the office per week. 

 


YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own day-to-day people support across your portfolio, with a primary focus on GTM. Be a practical point of contact for managers on performance, employee relations, team changes and developmen

jobs.title: HR Partner, AWS
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a dynamic, growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided companies of all sizes with an infrastructure platform in the cloud. Using AWS, companies can requisition compute power, storage, and other services – gaining access to a global computing infrastructure that is the backbone of Amazon.com’s multi-billion-dollar retail business. Today, AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers millions of active monthly customers from start-ups to multi-national corporations to governments.

At Amazon, we are committed to being Earth’s Best Employer and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic leaders passionate about making every day better for all employees (Builders) – and you would play a key role in that journey! Our HR Partners care deeply about the employee experience and support builders and managers to focus on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.

The HR Partner role in our Builder Experience Team (BeXT) focuses on the Builder experience. You will be working with business teams and other cross-functional HR teams in driving and deploying strategies. Great opportunity for a highly motivated, self-directed individual to gain valuable HR experience in a fast-paced, dynamic, globally scaling organization - and have fun doing it as an Amazonian!

Key job responsibilities
- Consult, coach, develop, and support leadership through decision making with empathy and sound judgement; collaborating and actioning on talent management processes, people development and performance management, compensation, and Employee Relations issues.
- Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders.
- Advocate for Builders’ needs through end-to-end experiences that help Builders feel fully engaged in the work they do and valued for who they are.
- Equita

jobs.title: Compensation Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s People team supports a complex, rapidly growing organization of researchers, engineers, and business teams. The Compensation function ensures accuracy, scalability, and operational excellence across all compensation tools, systems, and data flows.



About the Role

We’re hiring a Compensation Operations Analyst to build and run the systems, tools, and processes that power compensation at OpenAI. This role is deeply operational and technical: you will configure HRIS modules, manage compensation tools end-to-end, maintain pristine data quality, and ensure compensation cycles run flawlessly. You’ll partner closely with People Systems, Total Rewards, Finance, and vendors to keep our compensation infrastructure accurate, scalable, and audit-ready.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.



In this role, you will:

 - Own configuration and day-to-day operations of compensation tools and HRIS compensation modules.

 - Manage annual and off-cycle compensation processes, ensuring data integrity, testing, quality assurance, and on-time execution.

 - Build and maintain compensation datasets, dashboards, audits, and data flows across systems.

 - Lead compensation vendor relationships, including implementation, troubleshooting, and data submissions.

 - Diagnose and resolve system issues, identify root causes, and drive process and tooling improvements.

 - Partner with People Systems and Engineering to enhance architecture, workflows, and automation.

 - Ensure high data accuracy across compensation systems and proactively identify gaps, risks, or anomalies.

 - Translate technical or complex compensation system issues into clear guidance for stakeholders.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in compensation operations, HR operations/systems, or total rewards tooling in high-growth or technology environ

jobs.title: HRBP, Strategy, Finance, and People
jobs.description:
About this Team

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) team at OpenAI partners with leaders on complex organizational and talent decisions where the right path is not always obvious. We stay close enough to the business to understand how it works and focus our time on the decisions that benefit most from our judgment, context, and influence.

We work with urgency, empathy, and sound judgment. We value sincerity, intellectual honesty, and collaboration over ego.

About this Role

As a Senior HR Business Partner supporting Strategy, Finance, and People, you’ll help leaders translate company priorities into decisions about how to organize, where to build capability, and how to grow their teams. These functions often work across OpenAI, so you’ll help leaders clarify who owns decisions, how teams work together, and where responsibilities need to change as the company scales.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to an HRBP Lead. You’ll move between advising leaders on consequential choices and doing the hands-on work to put those decisions into practice.

In this role, you will:

 - Translate business plans into talent plans. Help leaders identify the capabilities they need, where to build or hire, and what to prioritize as resources and company needs shift.

 - Design teams for the work they need to do. Advise on structure, roles, and decision ownership, especially when responsibilities span multiple functions.

 - Coach leaders through high-stakes decisions. Give candid, actionable feedback and help managers navigate performance, succession, and team effectiveness with clarity and care.

 - Lead organizational change. Work with leaders to explain what’s changing and why, anticipate where teams will need support, and follow through after the announcement.

 - Improve how People programs work in practice. Partner with fellow HRBPs, People specialists, and cross-functional leaders to make performance, engagement, and talent processes useful and scalable.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Recruiting team helps bring together the people who advance our mission of ensuring artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We partner closely with leaders across the company to identify exceptional talent, build thoughtful hiring processes, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience.

This role supports Applied Foundations, partnering with engineering leaders to hire the managers and senior leaders who will help build and scale OpenAI’s foundational engineering capabilities.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced technical recruiter with a strong track record of hiring engineering leaders. You’ll own leadership searches from initial role definition and talent mapping through assessment, offer negotiation, and close.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior engineering leaders, helping clarify what each role requires, understand the talent market, and make thoughtful hiring decisions. You’ll bring the judgment to navigate ambiguous searches, the credibility to engage accomplished engineering leaders, and the persistence to build relationships well before someone is ready to make a move.

Experience in executive search or an in-house leadership recruiting function is particularly valuable. You should be equally comfortable shaping a search strategy and personally doing the work to deliver a successful hire.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead full-cycle searches for senior engineering leaders across Applied Foundations.

 - Partner with hiring leaders to define role scope, leadership expectations, technical requirements, and the outcomes a successful hire will deliver.

 - Develop talent maps and targeted search strategies, combining direct sourcing, referrals, market research, and long-term relationship building.

 - Engage passive leadership candidates through thoughtful outreach and substantive conversations about their experience, motivations, and potential impact at OpenAI.

 - Partner with hiring team

jobs.title: Systems & Enablement Lead, Recruiting Operations
jobs.description:
About the Team

At OpenAI, we are dedicated to building safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) to benefit all of humanity. Our mission attracts the world’s top talent across research, engineering, product, policy, and operations. OpenAI’s Recruiting Operations (RecOps) team provides the systems, workflows, and data foundation that power hiring at OpenAI. Within RecOps, the Systems & Enablement function owns the recruiting technology ecosystem—ensuring our ATS, offer workflows, and connected tools are reliable, well-governed, and user-centric.

About the Role

We are seeking a Systems & Enablement Lead, Recruiting Operations to lead improvements across recruiting processes, systems, and enablement. You’ll identify recurring friction, define the underlying problem, and carry solutions from an initial test through implementation, adoption, and a repeatable operating process.

You’ll partner with Recruiting leaders, People Systems, and hiring teams to translate hiring priorities into scalable processes and programs. You’ll align stakeholders on the most consequential problems, establish shared operating standards, and lead changes that improve recruiting effectiveness. Success means measurable improvements, sustained adoption, and clear ownership that enables teams to operate independently and adapt as hiring needs evolve.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead projects from discovery through adoption, managing scope, milestones, dependencies, and risks.

 - Owning enablement for operational workflow changes, including documentation, training, office hours, and change communication.

 - Supporting offer approval and other sensitive recruiting workflows through clear coordination, followthrough, and exception handling.

 - Identifying recurring support themes and driving fixes through process changes, documentation improvements, automation, or handoff to People Systems.

 - Partnering closely with recruiters, coordinators, People Systems, and cross functional stakeholders

jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re seeking a Contract Recruiting Coordinator for a temporary assignment through a staffing agency, supporting recruiting logistics and coordination for OpenAI.

 

In this role, you will:

 - Act as point of contact for candidates; coordinating, scheduling, and managing interviews as well as travel and accommodation arrangements when needed. Making sure everyone is in the right place at the right time.

 - Use Ashby (our ATS) and relevant recruiting tools to stay organized and help keep our busy team on track.

 - Work with our team to support OpenAI’s recruiting team. This will include supporting multiple functions, cross-training, hosting and scheduling support and completing assigned tasks.

 - Handle high-volume global scheduling of interviews: phone screens, video conferencing, presentations and onsite interviews.

 - Communicate updates to candidates regarding their applicant/interview status as needed.

 - Develop strong candidate and stakeholder relationships (Hiring Managers, Recruiting, etc.) and maintaining effective communication channels.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 2+ years of experience in a fast paced recruiting coordinator position.

 - Are passionate about candidate experience: we see our candidates as our guests, and we are their hosts. It is the coordinator's job to ensure a smooth experience.

 - Are detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to multitask.

 - An excellent communicator, both written and verbal. With an appropriate blend of professionalism and friendliness.

 - Are self-directed with a high sense of urgency while maintaining a meticulous attention to detail.

 - Anticipate possible issues before they arise and effectively problem-solves in advance. This includes independently making quick, educated decisions.

 - Have ability to maintain a high degree of professionalism and a calm demeanor.

About the Team

OpenAI’s People team hires, engages, and retains world-class talent to safely build and deploy AGI that benefits all of humanity. The People Analytics team helps leaders make better, evidence-based talent decisions.

About the Role

As a People Research Scientist, you will bring deep expertise in research design, measurement, experimentation, and applied data science to OpenAI’s most important People programs. You will design studies, evaluate people processes, and help leaders better empower employees, strengthen organizational systems, and deliver exceptional employee experiences.

This is a high-ownership individual contributor role combining hands-on research, methodological leadership, and scalable people science capabilities. We’re looking for an experienced researcher who can turn ambiguous People questions into rigorous designs, validated insights, and actionable recommendations.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or Mountain View, CA, with occasional travel to our San Francisco office.

What You’ll Do:

 - Design rigorous research and evaluation strategies for recruiting, organizational health, manager effectiveness, employee experience, and talent outcomes.

 - Apply advanced statistical modeling, machine learning, and research methods to inform program design, evaluate effectiveness, and quantify business impact.

 - Partner with People Operations, data engineering, and people systems teams to define data requirements, improve data quality, establish documentation standards, and ensure research datasets are governed, reproducible, and privacy-preserving.

 - Build scalable people science infrastructure, including self-service agentic tools, automated validation workflows, reusable research datasets and analytical pipelines.

 - Develop research playbooks that establish rigorous standards for study design, measurement, validation, and documentation, enabling high-quality, repeatable, and scalable research across the organization.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Native Learning and Credentials
jobs.description:
About the Team

Customer Education helps customers build the practical skills and confidence to use AI and OpenAI products safely and effectively. We bring together customer insight, learning and enablement expertise, product signals, and measurement to help organizations move from access to durable adoption.

We are exploring how learning, practice, assessment, and evidence of capability can become part of the product experience for people using ChatGPT, Codex, and other OpenAI products at work. Our work focuses on helping people build useful AI skills in the flow of work while giving organizations a clearer view of progress, capability, and readiness.

About the Role

As Product Lead, Native Learning & Credentials, you will define and drive a new product area at the intersection of AI, enterprise learning, assessment, and safe and beneficial use.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who is at their best close to the work. You will take a broad customer and business opportunity and make it concrete: identify the first problem worth solving, define the learner and enterprise journeys, sequence an initial product, and lead the work through engineering alignment, launch, measurement, and iteration. You will work with a small, cross-functional group.

We’re looking for people who combine product depth with GM-level ownership. You should be comfortable moving between customer needs, product strategy, technical architecture, operating design, evidence standards, and business outcomes. You will partner closely with engineering, design, program, learning, and assessment experts, bringing the judgment to make sound tradeoffs while respecting their domain expertise.
